line: Crowley's Six of Cups is the card for the second decan of Scorpio, with the Sun as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: The chapter gives the sign and the Sun in separate sentences; both are placed here.

quotes.quote: The Six of Cups is called Pleasure.
The zodiacal sign governing the card being Scorpio
influence is fortified by that of the Sun, who also represents the Six

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: Pleasure, in the title of this card, must be understood in its highest sense
